1935, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 349 May 18 Mrs. Anna Moreno - 43 - hard of hearing - had a very grevious sor- row - gave way to thinking of it - rim's
19 Edw'd Hobel - 3 - of 961 Garfield - lost speech given up as hopeless - eleven days without any nourishment. Enrolled March 21 50c - started picking up at once. Comes To-day in perfect health - & 5.00
19 Mrs. Mary Noonan - 35 - Ontario - has four small Ch., husband + three yrs. - wants to buy house in favorable .... One child invalid.
20 Geo Feeneny of Lansing - 45 - hopeless cancer of throat - Enrolled by phone To-day.
20 Mrs. Gardiner - Belle Vincent landlord former - threatened with evic- tion after paying more than $5000 on contract of Belle. Said Mrs. G. would like to keep house in home where only children.
Page 350 May 21 John Stei - 65 - stomach trouble fears cancer
Kate Doyle - 48 - in Kingston, Ontario - two years in cast - broken back - on back unable to move, enrolled about a year ago. Now asks prayers of thanksgiving that she is out of cast and able to sit up - can hardly believe it herself.
Alfred Powelec - 12 - Enemic, no blood - Enrolled March 18 - im- proved a little - Enrolled Today perpet. member. ... Book found ....
Mr. McDonald - 45 - Episcopelian - operated this a.m. for goiter - wife phones "so far not coming too ... prayed for before.
Barbara Kusmierz - 37 - broke neck four days ago, here To-day, has headaches, cannot rest or sleep or work.
Paper
Page 351 May 22
Mrs. Cath. Connolly - 54 - inward goiter several yrs.
Geo H. Edmiston - non c. - 38 - sinus, asthma, bronchitis - away in Arizona near 8 mo. ... now well but wife in meantime has become in- different - estranged. ..
Edw'd Knapp - 14 mo. - mastoid very very sick .. .
